name: Matomo
tagline: The full-featured Google Analytics replacement. 100% data ownership.
shortDescription: Matomo is the most feature-complete open source analytics platform. Heatmaps, session recordings, funnels, A/B testing, e-commerce tracking, custom reports, and 100% data ownership. Self-hosted in PHP/MySQL.
longDescription:
## What it is

Matomo (formerly Piwik) is the world's most popular open source web analytics platform. It was created in 2007 as a privacy-respecting alternative to Google Analytics and now powers analytics for 1.4+ million websites in 230+ countries.

## Why we recommend it

If you want every feature Google Analytics has and you want to own the data, Matomo is the answer. Heatmaps, session recordings, A/B testing, e-commerce revenue attribution, custom dimensions, raw data export, API access — it's all there, all open source, and you can self-host it on a $5/mo VPS.

## When to use it

- Compliance-sensitive industries (healthcare, finance, EU public sector)
- E-commerce sites that need full conversion attribution
- Any team that wants the power of GA without the privacy tradeoffs
- Sites that need heatmaps and session recordings as part of the analytics stack
installInstructions:
**Self-host:**
1. Requires PHP 7.4+ and MySQL/MariaDB
2. `wget https://builds.matomo.org/matomo.zip && unzip matomo.zip`
3. Serve the directory with nginx or Apache
4. Open in browser, follow the 5-minute installer
5. Add the tracking code to your site

**Managed (easier):** Matomo Cloud from €19/mo (100K pageviews). Includes all premium plugins.
pricingDetails: Self-host: free, GPL-licensed. Cloud: €19/mo starter (100K pageviews), €69/mo growth, €129/mo business. Premium plugins (Heatmaps, SessionRecording, A/B Testing) €99-€399/yr each.
